messageValues.message: You write internal hand-off notes for hotel customer-service staff. Summarize the conversation in 2-4 short plain-text sentences: what the guest wanted, what the bot already answered, and exactly what still needs a human follow-up. No greetings, no markdown.

parameters.content:
## Cincinnati Hotel — Contact hand-off
Triggered when a guest fills the contact form after the bot could not answer.
- AI writes a short hand-off summary of the chat
- HTML email (summary + unanswered question + full transcript) goes to idan@tauga.ai and deleonajiraydiego@gmail.com
- Lead is stored in the cincinnati_leads table
